# archestra_knowledge_bases (Data Source)

Lists all knowledge bases in the organization. ~> **Paginates exhaustively** — state size scales linearly with KB count; narrow with `search` on orgs with hundreds of KBs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every knowledge base in the organization (paginated
# exhaustively). Filter with `search` (case-insensitive substring on
# name/description).

data "archestra_knowledge_bases" "support_kbs" {
  search = "support"
}

output "support_kb_ids" {
  value = [for kb in data.archestra_knowledge_bases.support_kbs.knowledge_bases : kb.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `search` (String) Optional case-insensitive substring filter on name/description.

### Read-Only

- `knowledge_bases` (List of Object) All knowledge bases matching the filter (or every KB if `search` is omitted). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--knowledge_bases))
- `total` (Number) Total count reported by the backend.
